functions.name: ConnectionStringExpression
functions.description: Gets the connection string expression for the MySQL database.

functions.name: DatabaseName
functions.description: Gets the database name.

functions.name: JdbcConnectionString
functions.description: Gets the JDBC connection string for the MySQL database.
functions.remarks:
Format: `jdbc:mysql://{host}:{port}/{database}`.
User and password credentials are not included in the JDBC connection string. Use the `GetConnectionProperties` method to access the `Username` and `Password` properties.

functions.name: AddDatabase
functions.description: Adds a MySQL database to the application model.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name will be used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

fields.name: DatabaseName
fields.description: The name of the database. If not provided, this defaults to the same value as `name`.

functions.name: AddMySql
functions.description: Adds a MySQL server resource to the application model. For local development a container is used.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the container image.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource. This name will be used as the connection string name when referenced in a dependency.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: The parameter used to provide the root password for the MySQL resource. If `null` a random password will be generated.

functions.name: WithCreationScript
functions.description: Defines the SQL script used to create the database.
functions.remarks:
Default script is
```
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `QUOTED_DATABASE_NAME`;
```

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: The SQL script used to create the database.

functions.name: WithDataBindMount
functions.description: Adds a bind mount for the data folder to a MySql container resource.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source directory on the host to mount into the container.

fields.name: IsReadOnly
fields.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only mount.

functions.name: WithDataVolume
functions.description: Adds a named volume for the data folder to a MySql container resource.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the volume. Defaults to an auto-generated name based on the application and resource names.

fields.name: IsReadOnly
fields.description: A flag that indicates if this is a read-only volume.

functions.name: WithHostPort
functions.description: Configures the host port that the PGAdmin resource is exposed on instead of using randomly assigned port.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to bind on the host. If `null` is used, a random port will be assigned.

functions.name: WithInitFiles
functions.description: Copies init files into a MySql container resource.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source file or directory on the host to copy into the container.

functions.name: WithPassword
functions.description: Configures the password that the MySQL resource uses.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The parameter used to provide the password for the MySQL resource.

functions.name: WithPhpMyAdmin
functions.description: Adds a phpMyAdmin administration and development platform for MySql to the application model.
functions.remarks: This version of the package defaults to the tag of the container image.

fields.name: ConfigureContainer
fields.description: Callback to configure PhpMyAdmin container resource.

functions.name: WithRepl
functions.description: Adds a REPL command that opens an authenticated MySQL shell in the dashboard terminal dock.
functions.remarks:
This command is opt-in and available only in run mode. Dashboard users who can execute resource commands
can run commands with the resource's configured credentials. Enable it only for trusted dashboard users,
especially when sharing the dashboard through a tunnel or remote development environment.
